sections.heading: How to wear ?
sections.text:
✬ How To Wear: This Pendant can be attached to a keychain, kept in a wallet, hung in a certain room or best worn around the neck.

✬ Recharge: The best way to do that is to keep them in a place that gets moonlight, overnight. You can also put the crystal in salt for at least 15-20 minutes on normal nights.

✬ Cleansing: Once you receive your crystal, it is essential to do a cleansing and activating ritual to make this crystal YOURS! For that keep it immersed in simple salt or salt water for 5-10 minutes.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Some days feel heavier than others—and in those moments, having something simple that helps you stay calm can make a difference. The Anxiety Free Combo is designed exactly for that ✨

This set brings together an Opalite mesh weave pendant and a Howlite bracelet—two elements known for supporting a more relaxed and balanced mindset. Opalite is often associated with calming energy and smoother emotional flow, helping you feel less overwhelmed. Howlite, on the other hand, is known for its soothing nature, often linked with reducing stress and encouraging patience.

The pendant has a clean, minimal design that sits comfortably and works with any outfit, while the bracelet adds a subtle touch you can wear all day without effort. Together, they create a simple routine—you don’t have to think about, just wear them and go.

Whether you’re at work, travelling, or dealing with a busy day, this combo fits naturally into your lifestyle. It’s not about doing something extra—it’s about having something that quietly supports you.

Why You’ll Love It 😍

🧿 Dual Crystal Support

🧘 Helps Ease Daily Stress
💎 Minimal, Wearable Design
🎯 Everyday Comfort
✨ No Effort Needed

Made using 100% true Pyrite, ensuring the bracelet carries unique textures, natural variations, and authentic quality, supported by a rigorous multi-step quality testing process.

A simple yet elegant wear to make your everyday more prosperous—from India's Biggest Crystal Home Decor Brand 💙

• Stretch Elastic Thread (Bracelet) - Strong, flexible band that allows easy wear and a comfortable fit for most wrist sizes.

• Polished Surface Finish - Carefully finished stones for a clean look while preserving their natural patterns and texture.

• Hand-Assembled Crafting - Each piece is put together with attention to detail, ensuring balance, durability, and everyday usability.

sections.heading: FAQ
sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Q1. What crystals are included in this combo?

This set includes an Opalite mesh weave pendant and a Howlite bead bracelet, both selected for their calming and stress-supporting properties.

Q2. What is this combo mainly used for?

It’s designed to support a calmer mindset, help ease daily stress, and make you feel more balanced during busy or overwhelming situations.

Q3. Can I wear both pieces together?

Yes, they are meant to be worn together for a combined effect, but you can also wear them separately based on your comfort.

Q4. Is it suitable for daily wear?

Absolutely. Both the pendant and bracelet are lightweight, comfortable, and designed for everyday use.

Q5. Will the bracelet fit all wrist sizes?

The Howlite bracelet comes with a stretchable design, making it suitable for most wrist sizes.

Q6. Does it require any special care?

No special care is needed. Just keep it dry and clean it gently with a soft cloth when required.

Q7. Can I wear it while sleeping or bathing?

It’s recommended to remove it while bathing or sleeping to maintain its quality and durability.

Q8. Is this a good gifting option?

Yes, it’s a thoughtful gift for anyone looking for something simple that supports calmness and everyday balance.
